E       class UnicodeSafeFormatter(logging.Formatter):
E           def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
E               message = super().format(record)
E               stream_encoding = getattr(sys.stderr, "encoding", None) or "utf-8"
E               return message.encode(stream_encoding, errors="backslashreplace").decode(
E                   stream_encoding,
E                   errors="strict",
E               )

E       logger = logging.getLogger("ADSMOD.ML")
E       if not logger.handlers:
E           logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
E           console_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
E           console_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO)
E           console_handler.setFormatter(UnicodeSafeFormatter("%(levelname)s - %(message)s"))
E           logger.addHandler(console_handler)
E       logger.propagate = False
E       
E       
E       def configure_logging(log_directory: Path | None = None) -> None:
E           if log_directory is None:
E               return
E           try:
E               log_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
E               filename = (log_directory / "ADSMOD-ML.log").resolve()
E               for handler in list(logger.handlers):
E                   if not isinstance(handler, logging.FileHandler):
E                       continue
E                   if Path(handler.baseFilename).resolve() == filename:
E                       return
E                   logger.removeHandler(handler)
E                   handler.close()
E               file_handler = logging.FileHandler(filename, encoding="utf-8")
E               file_handler.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
E               file_handler.setFormatter(
E                   logging.Formatter(
E                       "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s",
E                       datefmt="%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S",
E                   )
E               )
E               logger.addHandler(file_handler)
E           except OSError:
E               logger.warning(
E                   "ML file logging is unavailable; continuing with console logging."
E               )
E       
E       
E       def close_file_logging() -> None:
E           for handler in list(logger.handlers):
E               if isinstance(handler, logging.FileHandler):
E                   logger.removeHandler(handler)
E                   handler.close()
